song_selection_both_modes_note: Quick Mode scans the original file. Long Mode scans tempo and pitch variations. Checking a song for both modes does not scan it twice: it is handled entirely inside the Long Mode batch, which also includes the original file, so nothing is missed and nothing is repeated.
